Packet G pure slice: planDraftSnapshot checks the proposed base revision against the supplied current revision, validates the existing node snapshot, and returns a candidate without writes. Table tests cover stable node IDs, opaque unknown content and style, and local-only undo with a newer peer edit. The eventual writer must still compare and write atomically. This leaves E0 and its manual phase gate open.

UPDATE 2026-11-11 (page_versions + atomic writer, dark): migration 20270346042000 adds public.page_versions (immutable tree per publish, service role only), pages.published_version_id, publish_page_version() (locks the page, takes the next revision, inserts the version, swaps the pointer, dual-writes published_data, one transaction) and revert_page_to_version() (one pointer swap). lib/page-editor/versions.ts wraps them and lists/reads versions; publishPage takes the versioned path only when EDITOR_CANVAS is on, and revertPageToVersion is the matching action. Order: merge, then apply the SQL in Frequency Community and record the ledger row, then the switch may go on. Remaining: the version-history panel (BLD-403), dropping published_data from the read path after a release, the bundle-byte instrument, the manual phase gate.
